title: Private Parts
writer: Philip Kearney, Les Rendelstein, Paul Bartel
actors: Ayn Ruymen, Lucille Benson, John Ventantonio
plot: Young Cheryl moves into her estranged aunt Martha's rundown King Edward Hotel. One of its offbeat residents, disturbed photographer George, takes special interest in her. Cheryl begins suspecting that a resident was murdered.
